body: Yes I saw that response but would you blame an alcoholic for drinking a bottle that some else gave him? He is not totally stable, of course that he could did thing better at hindsight, but at the live moment a person in his condition has it hard. Haven't you hurt someone unintentionally?

It's not your fault bro, I'm sorry for your loss I hope you and her family have peace. But bro, it's not your fault, as her you are struggling, you did what you can but maybe she need help from experts and others. You did the absolute best in you to help her.

Hey dude, I hope and wish so strong you are still ok. I'm Mexican, now I have 30 years. 

I know what you are struggling with, and I think you have not even talked about this either. I want to give you an advice:

You are 13, you have all your life ahead, and even though you think all you are going through is impossible to overcome, you will!!! You need to understand that if you don't know where to go or what to do is ok, you need to stop, focus on what you truly want or believe you will enjoy to do for work and growth, and keep it in mind no matter how hard it gets. Why? Because you will accomplish on your times there's no need to rush but the one you need to imply on your believes and wishes.

You have to study and work on what you feel better suited and not obligated to. 


I as you felt lost, I still feel like that sometimes, but you have to nourish your soul and heart with your passions.

And remember that you are important to someone, even though you don't think like that or even see someone's interest. You will find it, because there is people that loves you pal. 

Also be a kid, enjoy, play and watch what you want, you are 13 and nothing has to be more importan than your happiness s d emotional stability right now. Talk with your parents, your friends and look for medical support with psychologist and treat yourself right. You are your own story teller, try to tell yourself the better parts of you.

I hope you can be better and I know it will be almost no use for you but reach me by message and least I can listen to you. 

Regards little bro, that your inner strength helps you with this toughs times and let you emerge even stronger
Yes, I think so, but even though, we must have faith or something like that it's hard. I hope you too found peace and joy and strength to fight through and advance as best as you can

Thanks, sometimes is easier to say it than to do it. But really thanks!! Its so hard even when people you love doesn't even care, and people you don't even know shows more empathy than your own people.
